key.text: An engraved acrylic sign with my club's name for our tabling booth, about 12 inches wide. We need one.

output.summary: An engraved acrylic sign with your club's name, about 12 inches wide.

needs.why: Cut the acrylic and engrave the name

routes.process: Cut the sign shape from acrylic and engrave the letters with the laser cutter.
routes.fit_reason: The laser cutter (cuts flat sheets very precisely) can cut and engrave in one job. A 12 inch sign fits on its bed.

steps.title: Design the sign
steps.detail: Type the club name in a bold font and draw the outline at 12 inches wide.

steps.title: Take Level 1 training
steps.detail: Do the Level 1 orientation and safety training before using the laser cutter.

steps.title: Test on scrap
steps.detail: Engrave one letter on a small scrap piece to check depth and look.

steps.title: Cut the sign
steps.detail: Run the engrave and cut job, then peel the protective film.

warnings.fix: Use a bold font and letters at least half an inch tall.
